name: Twerk
author: BepHax
description: Get low and bounce. Loops until stopped.
comment: Bent-over bounce. The 55deg hinge (bend 0.9599) and torso y/z are HELD all cycle. Head y -1.88 / z -4.79 are solved through the bend-carry matrix so the head pivot lands on the chest's neck end (body pivot, model 0/5.12/-9.83) - the old 2.56/-4.92 buried it mid-back; re-solve if bend or torso y/z change. Motion per cycle: torso pitch pumps 61<->67 (pivots at the NECK, so it swings the hips and the shoulders stay anchored - keep the pump small, 16deg was a seizure), the butt bone does the main bounce (extra geometry from EmoteButt), the head nods -40<->-34 and the knees pump. Head y/z and arm channels key at tick 4 only, so they hold. Cape 55/0.92/-1.77 is solved to CANCEL the bend carry to zero: the cape render layer already rides the pitched body matrix, so any leftover carry double-rotates the cape down through the legs; with the carry nulled it just drapes along the back, and the 45 at the pop frame leaves +10deg of flap kick. Re-solve alongside the head if the bend changes.
